can you bring a Korean skincare haul in your carry-on?

Each liquid must be 100 ml or less, all in one clear 1-liter bag. Incheon Airport uses the same rule.

Bought it at duty free? Keep it sealed in the duty-free bag until your last flight. Connecting flights can still screen it again.

Flying home to the US? The standard duty-free allowance for returning residents is $800. Declare everything you bought.

Save this before you pack your haul.

Sources: Incheon Airport security guide, TSA liquids rule, US CBP (Jan 2026).
